## Context / Problem
Entering the review-bot ASGI lifespan from an ordinary test starts the real backfill reconciler and snapshot janitor, while shutdown reads the production 1200-second queue-drain default. The idiomatic `with TestClient(app)` path can therefore turn a unit test into a long-running background sweep/hang. The production default is intentional and must not change: `src/rebar/review_bot/config.py:49` defines `DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS = 1200`, and `shutdown_drain_seconds()` at `src/rebar/review_bot/config.py:92` already accepts a positive `SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS` override.

## Approach
Use the existing environment knob in the root pytest harness to pin `SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS=1.0` for every test. In `tests/unit/test_review_bot.py`, add one module autouse fixture that stubs `reconcile.reconcile_loop` and `rebar._snapshot.start_background_janitor` by default. A registered `real_reconcile_loop` marker will explicitly bypass only the reconciler stub for tests that exercise the real loop; the janitor remains stubbed because its filesystem sweep is unrelated to those contracts.

The full string-reference inventory is deliberate: remove the identical idle-reconciler plus no-op-janitor setup at current lines 1446-1449, 1474-1477, and 1615-1618. At lines 1232-1237, retain the test-specific `fake_start` janitor override because that test observes start/stop signaling, but use the new default idle reconciler instead of its duplicate. At lines 1723-1725, retain the test-specific `_slow_reconcile_loop` override because it is the shutdown-cancel fault injection, while removing its redundant no-op janitor patch. This centralizes safe defaults without shadowing tests whose contract requires a specialized fake.

## Scope
- `tests/conftest.py`: register the opt-out marker and set the exact suite-wide `SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS=1.0` baseline that individual tests may override.
- `tests/unit/test_review_bot.py`: add the module autouse stubs and RED-first lifespan/escape-hatch coverage; remove redundant per-test stubs while retaining the classified purpose-specific overrides.
- No production files change; `src/rebar/review_bot/config.py` remains the authoritative production default and parser.

## Testing
- RED oracle: enter the real app lifespan through `TestClient` without any per-test background-task stubs and require a prompt successful health response; before the module fixture exists, the focused test is bounded by pytest-timeout and fails instead of inheriting a long shutdown.
- Default path: the new autouse fixture makes the lifespan test prompt while the suite-wide environment value is exactly `1.0`.
- Escape hatch: a `real_reconcile_loop`-marked lifespan test replaces only `reconcile_once` with a deterministic observable fake and proves the production `reconcile_loop` actually runs.
- Override/control: the existing drain-specific test sets `SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS=0.1` and remains green; the stop-grace test continues to compute its floor from `DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS`, pinning the production 1200-second constant.
- Gates: focused pytest nodes first, then `make check` and `make test` using the worktree virtualenv; CI additionally exercises the required optional-extra lane.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every pytest test receives the exact `SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS=1.0` baseline; verified by a root-conftest contract test and the focused review-bot tests.
- [ ] The production default remains 1200 seconds; verified by the unchanged `DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS` and the existing stop-grace-period test.
- [ ] A test-local `SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS=0.1` override wins over the suite baseline; verified by `test_lifespan_drain_is_bounded` remaining green.
- [ ] Entering the review-bot lifespan is safe by default with no per-test reconciler/janitor stubs; verified by a new prompt TestClient health-path regression test.
- [ ] All five existing string-referenced stub sites are classified: three identical setup sites are removed, the janitor-wiring test retains only its observable janitor fake, and the slow-cancel test retains only its fault-injection reconciler; verified by focused tests and the final grep/diff.
- [ ] A marked test explicitly runs the real production `reconcile_loop`; verified by an observable `reconcile_once` signal during lifespan startup.
- [ ] The worktree passes `make check`, `make test`, Gerrit `LLM-Review +1`, and Gerrit `Verified +1` before submission.
